about_the_game:
A Retro Sci-Fi Survival Shooter

Something has gone terribly wrong in the research facility.
The scientists are gone, the experiments are loose, and the intercom still whispers orders that no one should follow.

You weren’t supposed to be here.
But now, you’re the only one who can uncover the truth behind Directive Axiom.

🧪 About the Game

Directive Axiom is a first-person retro sci-fi shooter that blends tense combat, environmental storytelling, and unsettling atmosphere. Inspired by classics from the PS1/PS2 era, every corridor and laboratory hides fragments of a mystery buried deep within the facility.

Explore abandoned research wings, scavenge weapons and supplies, and survive encounters with hostile experiments that were never meant to escape. The truth won’t come easily you’ll have to fight for it.

🔑 Key Features

  • Immersive Retro Visuals
    A PS1/PS2-inspired art style captures the eerie grit of old-school sci-fi shooters.

  • Atmospheric Exploration
    Navigate laboratories, sealed doors, and decaying machinery filled with hidden logs, cryptic clues, and fragments of the past.

  • Tense Combat
    Face mutated experiments, security drones, and other threats using prototype weapons and improvised defenses.

  • Unnerving Intercom System
    Random announcements echo through the halls, guiding, misleading, or unsettling you as you dig deeper into the directive.

  • A Mystery to Uncover
    Piece together what happened in the facility, and decide whether the directive should be followed or destroyed.

🎵 Tone & Inspiration

If you grew up on Half-Life, System Shock, or Quake II, Directive Axiom is built in that spirit: retro sci-fi shooter design with a darker, more psychological edge. Grit, mystery, and atmosphere are just as important as gunplay.

name: Directive Axiom

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p at low-medium settings. Players can expect ~60 FPS on recommended minimum GPUs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 1440p at high-ultra settings. On modern high-end hardware (RTX 4070 + i9-12900K), performance averages 165 FPS with a 1% low of 120 FPS and 0.1% low of 57 FPS (~6ms frame times).

short_description: Directive Axiom is a retro sci-fi FPS set in a decaying research facility. Explore abandoned labs, battle hostile experiments, and uncover a buried truth in a world inspired by the eerie atmosphere of classic late-90s shooters.
